english.title: Producer or representative fail to comply with regulation 11(1), 12(1) or 19 before joining new scheme

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[a producer]_
(B)_[an authorised representative]_

who had been notified under regulation 14(9) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013 that approval of the old scheme had been withdrawn and having benefited from an exemption under regulation 14(7) or (8) of those regulations by virtue of membership of that scheme, failed to comply with

(C)_[an obligation that you had under regulation 11(1) until you joined the new scheme]_
(D)_[an obligation that you had under regulation 12(1) until you joined the new scheme]_
(E)_[regulation 19]_

in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 14(10), 90(1)(a) and 91(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
